title: Kropki Lies
author: Avelpuzzles
rules:
Solve it: Sven's SudokuPad

Rules:

• Normal 6x6 Sudoku rules apply: place the digits 1–6 once each in every row, column, and 2x3 box.

• Auxiliary Cells: There are additional cells outside the main 6x6 grid (the "Digit" and "Value" columns) which must also be filled with digits 1–6.

• Liar Cells: Every row, column, and 2x3 box in the main 6x6 grid contains exactly one liar cell, whose real value is different from the digit placed in that cell.

• All 6 liar cells contain different digits (a full set of 1–6).

• All 6 liar cells have different real values (a full set of 1–6).

• The table on the right tracks the Digit and its corresponding Value for each of the 6 liar cells.

• Kropki Dots (Values):

• Cells separated by a white dot must have real values with a difference of 1.

• Cells separated by a black dot must have real values in a 1:2 ratio.

• Negative Constraint: No two orthogonally adjacent cells in the 6x6 grid may have real values with a difference of 1 or a 1:2 ratio unless separated by the corresponding dot. (Note: If two adjacent cells have real values of 1 and 2, either a white or a black dot must be present).
solutionCode: enter value column from top to bottom
